description: Conductor Cloud API client with bounded coding-agent launch, monitor, steering, and reporting workflows.

novel_features.name: Launch
novel_features.description: Create a workspace and first session, send a brief, and return the Conductor deep link.

novel_features.name: Monitor
novel_features.description: Poll a session until real completion while streaming only new transcript events.

novel_features.name: Steer
novel_features.description: Send follow-up guidance to an existing Conductor session with a clear delivery receipt.

novel_features.name: Run
novel_features.description: Launch, monitor, and collect the final transcript and deep link with explicit timeout rules.

novel_features.name: Plan and implement
novel_features.description: Keep a planner or reviewer session separate from the implementation session in one workspace.

novel_features.name: Daily report
novel_features.description: Return recent Conductor session rows and mechanical activity totals from transcript search.
